# Eco-Business

> Eco-Business is Asia Pacific's leading platform for climate action, sustainability reporting, and green finance news covering decarbonization, ESG disclosure, and sustainable development across the region.

Eco-Business delivers comprehensive coverage of climate policy, maritime emissions, corporate sustainability reporting (ISSB standards, Scope 3 emissions), and green finance mobilization across Asia Pacific. The platform also hosts events and initiatives like Changing Course that convene stakeholders on climate and sustainability challenges.

## Key Topics

- Green Finance
- Decarbonization
- Scope 3 Emissions
- Sustainability Reporting
- ISSB Standards
- Climate Action
- Maritime Emissions
- Asia Pacific
- ASEAN Markets
- Circular Economy
- Plastic Pollution
- Climate Policy
- GHG Disclosure
- Sustainable Development
- COP30

## Flagship Initiatives & Events

- [Changing Course](https://changingcourse.eco-business.com): Flagship climate initiative by Eco-Business exploring global climate story
- [Eco-Business Events](https://events.eco-business.com): Directory of Eco-Business events on clean tech and sustainable development
- [Realising Scope 3 Reporting and Disclosure in ASEAN](https://events.eco-business.com/events/realising-scope-3-reporting-and-disclosure-in-asean): Fireside chat on Scope 3 emissions reporting in ASEAN with ISSB adoption trends
- [Charting the course: CLEAN pathways in Asia's energy transition](https://events.eco-business.com/events/charting-the-course-the-role-of-clean-lng-in-asias-energy-transition): Roundtable on low-emissions LNG and maritime decarbonization in Asia
- [Sustainability Media Academy (SMA) Season 4](https://events.eco-business.com/events/sustainability-media-academy-sma-season-4): Virtual journalism forum on climate stories and geopolitics in Asia Pacific
